If I need tons of power, then I use my mammoth pressure washer which is powerful enough to clean up my neighbors lawn (6 houses away), but the setup and knock-down time takes a considerable amount of time and effort.Remember, this is a portable sweeper/broom.  Don't think it will blow all the wet leaves off of your lawn.
summary: It's a great sweeper. I love it.

reviewText: I have a black and decker cordless weed eater and I just love it so I was very excited to try out this little blower. I used it mainly in our bricked and flagstoned areas and blew stuff like bird seed chaff, leaves, dirt, dried piles of chicken pooh, straw, and other debris that seems to blow into the courtyard every day.The blower is surprisingly strong. There is a meter on it that shows you how much charge you have left. When I started blowing the battery was full. After about 25-30 minutes on high there was still one bar left (out of 4) and the blower didn't seem to have slowed down.It has a power wheel and I had it turned to 6 the whole time (1 being the lowest, 6 the strongest).I thought it did a fantastic job. It was not quite as strong as my electric blower, but that one can dig holes in hardened dirt in a few seconds. This one did a great job blowing away dried mud on concrete and cleaned up areas where sand and dirt had concentrated from being wet repeatedly.The best thing about it is how handy, light, and quiet it is. It is tiny and sits between my housekeeping area fridge and the wall. It weighs about as much as a power drill and it sounds quieter than some of the hair dryers I've used.The unit feels substantially built and the battery and charging station are nice and sturdy for such a small tool. If this batter lasts half as long as my weed whacker has (over 4 years now) I will be thrilled.

reviewerName: Sir Charles Panther "Life is hard.  It's hard...
reviewText: I got this for the wife for Mother's Day--at her request--and this has been a great hit.  She absolutely love it, for the jobs she does, like blowing off the deck, clearing the garage, blowing off the front porch and sidewalks, etc.  It works just right for her in these jobs, and the weight is perfect for her.  For that reason, the product is a clear winner.But for big blowing jobs this isn't really the tool to use.  You need heavy-duty corded power if you're going blow the driveway, blow leaves in the yard, etc.  I've got a heavy-duty WeedEater blower for this that is going on 12 years old, and it works like a charm.  Yeah, it's corded, but it works great.I note with interest that an additional/replacement battery for this product is $88.  That means, I guess, that this blower if worth about $51.  Does that mean it's a cheap blower?  I dunno.One note on the battery and charger: make sure that you don't leave the battery in the charger for a long time (more than 24 hours) or you'll ruin both the battery and the charger.  And if you leave the charger plugged in for a long time you'll also ruin that.  Plug it all in to charge, and as soon as you're done get it all unplugged.

Contrary to the #1 review, while a nice video and brings out some good points, leaves aren't sprinkled gently on the ground and remain loose and free to be easily blown away. By the time we usually get to them mother nature has worked them into the grass with some kind of velcro and the rains have waited them down. This does work best for hard surfaces like concreted and may do well on gravel areas if the leaves aren't to wet and heavy. For grass I actually grabbed a rake, this just takes too long to work the leaves out.But for our 65 foot long porch and sidewalks, driveway, etc this does a great job.
Very lightweight and easy to use. The battery holds a charge for a surprisingly long time. I like the quiet motor. Good tool.

The directions say that safety gear is needed, and these items are not included, so if you are purchasing this sweeper, safety gear will be an added expense.The sweeper is easy to assemble, use, and the included charger is easy to use as well.  The directions are extremely long and rather tedious.  In fact, they take longer to read than does the assembly of the sweeper.

I own both this and an older 20-volt version (Black & Decker LSW120 20-Volt Lithium-Ion Cordless SweeperBetween the two units, I like this much more.  It's more powerful, quieter, and has a substantially longer battery life.  This also has an adjustable fan speed, so it can be run at lower volume when necessary.  I don't know exactly how this compares to the newest 20-Volt version, but it blows away the older one.If you can afford the extra cost, it's well worth it.
summary: I own both this and an older 20-volt version...

reviewText: I purchased this sweeper for my 82 year-old father-in-law that suffers from severe arthritis in his hands.  He loves to garden and work outside but has increasing difficulty using his tools.  The sweeper is very lightweight and easy to grasp for him.  Assembly time/difficulty was minimal and he didn't have to fumble with cords like his other blower.  The noise levels are lower than a normal blower and it handles most sweeping jobs.  I gave it four stars because it could have been a little bit stronger.  I know its not a leaf blower but some sweeping jobs were a little more difficult than others.  Despite this one drawback, my father-in-law loves it.

I love this thing. The air stream is pretty strong and it's great for cleaning my walks and driveway. I also used it to blow out my garage and it works great for that though I recommend you wear a respirator. I am in the process of changing my riding mower belt and the blower worked great for cleaning out caked up grass under the belt cover. The battery lasts long enough to do both walk and driveway. I woudn't expect it to move huge piles of leaves like a commercial blower but for small stuff it works great.

My mother used to pay a man a hundred dollars to tune up her lawn mower. Maybe I am just the suspicious type, but other than taking the money, he didn't seem to do anything to the mower. If it was sluggish before he took it, it was worse after. I figured I could do an equally bad job for less. Luckily I became aware of this kit which save me from the daunting task of collecting the necessary materials. The plastic kit consists of a funnel top and an oil pan base. Included are oil, fuel stabilizer, a spark plug and an air filter. Tune up was easy and the mower runs smoothly with power. I like the convenience and the fact that every part of the kit has a purpose. this kit makes it easy to keep on top of small engine maintenance. Recommended.

The kit is convenient for homeowners or professionals alike. I think especially homeowners rarely maintain mowers. Professionals could probably perform maintenance more than once during the season. The kit has everything needed except for sharpening the blades.The spark plug would normally cost 3 to 4 dollars.The air filter would normally cost a little more than 6 dollars.The oil is usually a little over 5 dollars.The fuel stabilizer normally comes in larger containers for at least 6 dollars.Therefore, all this might cost 21 dollars and take time to purchase. It's a good deal.

Keeping small engines running for years basically comes down to using fresh fuel, regular oil changes, and simple maintenance. This kit is a one-stop shop that addresses all the major issues.It contains fuel stabilizer to keep gas from gumming up the carb (and also lets you avoid the messy task of draining the fuel in the off-season). Next is a quart of oil (SAE 30) for oil changes, followed by a spark plug and an air cleaner filter replacement. I used mine on my Honda-engine pressure washer with excellent results.Each part could be purchased less expensively at an auto parts or small engine shop (or big box hardware store, but they tend to be hit and miss when it comes to certain parts, especially air filters). The advantage of this kit is ease of purchase (just one click). Plus, the package it comes in serves as a collection bin for the old oil until you can get it to a recycling center (please don't dump it down a drain or outdoors!).Pricy, but convenience always costs. Definitely worth getting if you want a one-stop solution to small engine maintenance.
summary: Easy solution for an essential task

reviewText: The Champion tune-up kits have everything you need in one kit. It includes the air filter, spark plug, oil and  fuel stabilizer.This one is for Honda 3.5 - 5 HP vertical engines. GV150, GV200, GVX120, GVX140, GVX1210Champion Spark Plug - Part # RN9YCHonda Air Filter : 17210-ZE6-003, 17210-ZE6-505, 17211-888-013The package is very convenient, you get everything you need in one kit and the container also can be used to for a drain pan and funnel. The funnel could be kept if you need one or you can just top the bottom back off with the used oil in it and dispose of it properly.Great deal for the price and a brilliant idea to include everything in a kit. Takes out having to guess as to which parts you need for your motor. The price for the kit is cheaper than if you bought all the pieces separately.
This had everything I needed to tune up my push mower...I am a girl and this made it so easy...it was all really self explanitory

I have had numerous kits for my mowers over the years but none as well thought out as this one. Instead of just a disposable cardboard box to hold the items someone came up with the clever idea of providing a reusable container. The top half transforms into a very handy funnel and the bottom half becomes a receptacle for draining old oil. This kit contains all the items required to service the mower and made tuning up my mower an easy task. Bravo to Champion for their ingenuity and their consideration of consumer needs. In an era when most products seem to be poorly constructed and over priced it is a pleasant surprise to find such a well designed and affordable necessity. My next kit requirement will be provided by Champion.
This is everything you need to tune up the lawn mower. The top is even a funnel. I love how it all goes in a cute little container. It even has the oil, spark plug and filter.
summary: everything you need for the lawn mower

reviewText: i used this tune up kit on my snapper roto tiller.  it is a basic generic kit.  the only thing that i could really use was the oil and plug.  for a generic kit it was good.  but for specific applications you will need to get the individual parts
summary: big boy tune up kit for roto tiller

reviewText: This is a smart set. If you are like us, chances are you have bits of this and that hanging around the shed; motor oil here, spark plug there, drain pan somewhere...you get the hidea. I affectionately refer to the shed and garage as the "black hole" because what goes in never seems to make its way out again and we always end up at the store buying this or that.So, the first thing most people will notice is that the container is actually a funnel and drain pain which is super smart and convenient. I hate packaging that is bad for the environment and takes up space in the trash but this actually serves a purpose and is sized right. Next, the spark plug, filter and fluid is all packed inside and designed so you can do the maintenance all at once. The value seems solid especially compared to buying each individually and I like the time saving aspect. I got two because we actually have a couple of mowers - one we use for personal and one we use for rentals. Both arrived in good order, both are convenient and both seemed well priced.
summary: Smart Set - Well designed all in one maintenance solution

reviewText: I actually got the kit for Troy Built mowers and loved it so much I ordered this kit for another mower. I'm the kind of person who buys a device and runs it until it dies. I often don't do maintenance on them mainly because I don't think about it until after its too late. This kit makes maintenance easy by giving you the fuel stabilizer, air filter, oil, spark plug and place to drain the oil into and it turns a dreaded saturday afternoon task into a 15 minute tune up. It has brought my mower back to full strength and this is a mower I've used for around 5 years with no maintenance. It's amazing to hear the difference in the engine and is making me wish they would put this on auto delivery so that it would ship to me each season so I don't have to think about it!Great concept, worked amazingly well as long as you order the right kit, the only real difference that I can tell is the shape of the air filter. If you aren't sure what type of filter you need, pull it out and compare it to the pictures to identify which one looks right. For me the spark plug was an afterthought but it was a perfect match once I found the right air filter type.
summary: Great idea! Makes mower maintenance a breeze

reviewText: This kit is convenient and includes all champion branded items.The kit includes Champion brand oil SAE30, air filter, spark plug and fuel stabilizer all neatly packaged in a plastic container that doubles as a funnel and drain pan.  Just be sure the oil is the right type and viscosity for your mower.Pros:-All in one kit saves having to shop around.-Includes container that can be used as a drain pan and funnel.Cons:-Depending on your brand of mower, parts may not be exact replacements (spark plug for example).  If you buy the kit for a B&S;, you are most likely to get OEM parts or exact replacements but not so for a Honda or other brand of mower.-Container will leak if knocked over.  Top and bottom pieces do not fit very tightly.  After you fill the mower with oil, I'd transfer the used oil to a different container.

This is a great value.  It's got everything you need to tune up a lawnmower or tiller into great shape- just make sure you get the right kit for your needs because the spark plug and oil filter need to fit your engine.  It stores really well.  The shape of the container makes it very compact and neat on a shelf.The container itself functions as a funnel and a pan for when you remove old, used fluids.  It's all Champion brand so it's quality stuff.  It has 4 products in it that would cost you a lot more than this if bought separately.

I really like the idea of this.This complete tune up kit fits Honda lawn mower engines (3.5 to 5 HP) and comes with spark plug, air filter, 4-cycle oil and fuel stabilizer. The package itself converts to an oil funnel and drain pan. It's a neat design and a genius idea to have everything you need packaged together.Note: Unfortunately, the oil funnel in my package was cracked during shipping which, of course, ruined the funnel. The five stars are based on the product itself.

This kit is great. It came with everything we needed and I love that the lid doubles as a funnel and the container doubles as a drain pan. Not one piece of this kit is wasted packaging!The items in the kit are the same items you'd get at your local hardware/auto parts store (without having to buy them separately). Having everything you need to do a tune-up in one kit is really convenient and the price is very reasonable for everything that's included. If all you need is a bottle of oil or a spark plug obviously this kit isn't for you but for doing a true tune-up this kit is great.All in all an excellent product!

Included in the kit is:* Champion Spark Plug #RN9YC* Honda Air Filter: 17210-ZE6-003, 17210-ZE6-505, 17211-888-013* End of Season Fuel Stabilizer 2.5fl oz* Oil SAE 30W SJ20 FL OZThe packaging even converts to oil drainage and storage complete with funnel. An added bonus if you ask me. Everything worked great and we are back to moving the perpetually growing lawn now. Great buy.

After ordering and successfully using a similar kit by this company I knew I could use one to tune up my grandmother's as well. The kit is easy to use and offers easy to follow directions. I would recommend these to anyone who can follow written directions.

I used this kit to tune up my Honda Power washer. Everything was there including a small bucket to drain the old oil into. The spark plug, air filter and oil was there to change and it might have taken me 15 minutes to do. Thats a good thing. I will consider buying these for my lawnmower and generator. Recommended
summary: Excellent Kit to tune up your small engine.

reviewText: This is so handy!  First of all the container is so cool.  The top part comes off and it becomes a funnel, leaving the bottom part for a bucket.  Then the little thing of oil and the filter are great too!  I didn't have an immediate need for it, but I have it in my garage and I'm certain I'll be able to use it.  It's nice to know those things are there for when I need them.

Champion may have hit a home run with this item.  It is handy and complete in one package.  My only concern is that the funnel and drain pan will probably end up in land fills.  I am keeping both as they are good tools for my other small engine devices and motorcycle, but a great many other people will see them as disposable.

Loved how all of the things you needed for a tune up was all in one neat and convient packaging. You can even use the plastic top as a funnel(which I did). The four cycle oil was the most important thing for me. Used all of the items that are provided.Very handy!

When I was a kid, our neighbor used to pour his used motor oil down the storm drain. My Dad, a chemist and friend of the environment, used to give him hell for it, and they had a some memorable discussions about that subject. Thankfully most folks have gotten a little smarter about these things and learned the importance of recycling oil rather than discarding it in an unsafe manner. But that doesn't make it any easier to deal with, and frankly, a lot of people have buckets or drums full of spent oil in their garages--which is its own kind of problem waiting to happen. The new Champion Lawn and Garden Tune-Up kits solve the problem in a most intelligent manner--by packaging all the supplies you need for a spring lawn mower tuneup in a (hopefully) spillproof container that you can use to collect the old oil and take it directly to your local recycling center. The idea is brilliant, and the designers should be commended. I ordered one of these kits and it's exactly as advertised--everything you need to do the job and clean up the mess in a simple and reasonably economical package. Highly recommended!
summary: Smart packaging makes changing oil easier and solves the problem of what to do with the old oil

reviewText: This kit comes with all you need to maintain your Honda mower: the motor oil, air filter, spark plug and a fuel additive.  The packaging also doubles as a funnel and oil pan for your convenience.The positives:  the kit has everything you need to keep your mower running.  I don't think I'd use this kit every year but having gone a few years with no maintenance it's time to change the oil, filter and spark plug for sure.  The negatives: the funnel and oil pan are a bit flimsy so plan on using your own.  Also the fuel stabilizer is measured for five gallons.  I don't typically fill my tank since I don't want the gasoline sitting in the mower for a long time. There are no instructions for measuring out the stabilizer so I'm not sure if I will use it.But all-in-all this is a nice kit and for the price you can't go wrong.
summary: A nicely packaged all-in-one maintenace kit

reviewText: This clever kit successfully incorporates the kitchen concept of mise en place to lawn machine maintenance.  In a kitchen, mise en place means making sure all the ingredients needed are in place before you begin cooking. This kit provides everything you need for small engine tune up, including the oil, spark club, air filter and fuel stabilizer in a convenient package that doubles as a funnel and oil pan. Having everything in one place is half the  battle.  Tune up on my mulcher was a snap and it seems to have new life. This kit makes maintenance easy and  which makes it more likely to be done.  Recommended.
summary: Mise En Place for Mulcher Maintenence

reviewText: I love that this kit is all inclusive. Everything you need when you know nothing about changing the oil in a lawnmower is here in this box. The box works as an oil pan and a funnel. This is really cool, because even after I found someone to help me change the oil, I was still left with my meager excuse for tools. I didn't want to use my kitchen funnels for an oil change. What if I ever needed to use them in the kitchen?

I know I should regularly change the oil in my lawn mower and pressure washer, but it always seems to fall off of the to-do list. This all-in-one kit is an easy way to get the job done.In addition to a quart of SAE 30 oil it has a bottle of fuel stabilizer to keep gas from gumming up the carb, a spark plug, and an air cleaner filter replacement. Basically all the parts needed to keep a small gas engine working well.It's packaged in a two-part plastic case that serves as both a funnel for the oil, plus a container to store the used oil to bring it to a recycling center.The kit is more expensive than buying all the components separately, but having everything at hand all at once, plus having a bin to store the used oil makes this a worthwhile purchase. Highly recommend.
summary: Makes a messy job much more convenient

reviewText: We were going to take the Honda Mulcher in because it was spurting a bit and we thought it needed a tune up. When this was offered by Vine I decided to hold off and let my husband take a crack at it.The packaging and this set is cleverly designed and contains everything needed. The packaging converts to a funnel and drip pan that you can toss instead of cleaning after the oil is recycled.My husband got the job in 30 minutes. Drained the oil, inserted and adjusted the spark plug, added new oil, and took it for a test run. The sputtering vanished and now all he has to do is sharpen the blade.I think this is a really clever product which probably saved me $50-$70 and an extended stay at the repair shop. I highly recommend it as an alternative to a professional tune-up. My only other advice is to recycle the old oil responsibly.

Hats off to Champion for putting together such a handy kit to simplify an otherwise daunting task of rounding up all the necessary supplies for a simple lawn mower tune up.  Though I have not actually used the kit as yet, I have inspected the kit closely, and I am in awe.  OK, maybe that is overstating it a bit.  I mean who, really, could be in AWE of a lawn mower tune-up kit?  A nerd is all I can imagine, and a nerd I am not.  BUT I DIGRESS!Getting back to the kit, I defy anybody to round up all the stuff by yourself, making sure it is the right stuff, and to do so for less expense than you would incur by buying this kit.  Even if you could somehow buy the stuff for less than the price of this kit, your time is worth something, and this kit will save you time.  I guarantee it.  Well, I don't actually guarantee it, but you get my drift.  This is about convenience.  It's like Hamburger Helper with the hamburger in the box, except that would be really gross and nobody would buy it.  People will buy this--I, for one.  I will also recommend it to others, though it will hardly make for good dinner party conversation.  I will have to think of the right time to recommend it, but I will.
summary: Great Idea, Great Design, Great Value!

reviewText: The Champion tune-up kits have everything you need in one kit. It includes the air filter, spark plug, oil and  fuel stabilizer.This one is for Honda engines 5HP and up.Champion Spark Plug - Part # RN11YC4Honda Air Filter - 17211-Z68-000, 17211-Z68-003The package is very convenient, you get everything you need in one kit and the container also can be used to for a drain pan and funnel. We kept the funnel in case we need one again.Great deal for the price and a brilliant idea to include everything in a kit. Takes out having to guess as to which parts you need for your motor.

Champion makes a great all in one kit for your Honda mower.  It's a convenient package and if you need to do the entire maintenance at once, it is a great bargain.Included in the kit are:Champion Spark Plug # RN11YC4Honda Air Filter: 17211-Z68-000 / 17211-Z68-0032.5 oz Champion Fuel Stabilizer (good for 6.25 gallons of gasoline)Champion Brand SAE 30W SJ 20 oz oil.The package converts to the drain pan and oil funnel, and when you are finished changing the oil, you can put the funnel lid and cap back on and take it to the nearest oil recycling center.If you need all these parts and the part model numbers match what you need, then this kit is for you.  I highly recommend it.

Just finished the annual spring mower maintenance with this kit and it's a winner for the price. Gapped and changed the spark plug, installed the air filter and changed the oil all in less than 30 minutes. The air filter fit perfectly as did the spark plug ( this required a minor gap adjustment). All of the parts are non-oem and just may have an effect on your warranty so be sure to read the fine print on your owners manual if that is a concern to you. I didn't use the fuel conditioner as I use a different brand that I'm happy with.The plastic "funnel" and "container" are less than useful, you'll probably use your own as they are flimsy and most likely won't survive the trip to the recycling center with your used oil. Overall it has everything you need contained in a flimsy dual use container at a considerable savings over Honda brand parts.
summary: Everything you need in one place

reviewText: i used this on my pressurewasher that has a 9 horse honda motor.  it is a good basic kit.  the air filter did not fit but i can adapt it to another motor i have.  the plug did not fit but again i can adapt that to another motor.  like i said it is a good basic kit probably for the 5 horse honda motor.  but check the numbers for the parts in the kit 1st before installing to see if the plug, air filter are what is suggested.
summary: champion tuneup kit for honda motors

reviewText: We used this for our bigger mower. This is a great product for teaching a kid about engine maintenance. I liked having all of the kit there and not worrying about forgetting something. The cost seems comparable to trying to assemble the elements separately.I was very surprised at how sturdy the funnel is. I stumbled and smashed it between me and the shop bench but it was fine.

Hey, let's face it, we all hate taking care of the lawn mower, right? We use it and we put it away and forget it. But now that's all over.I liked the dirty oil bag to take down to the recycling yard and put into the used oil tank. Spark plug was good, too. Half the work is finding the right one. DONE!Also like the fuel stabilizer. Gotta have it! Remember to run the mower to get it into the carb.Now we're going to take care of our mowers, right, guys? This kit makes it easy to do the right thing. Now it's up to you.

This is a smart set. If you are like us, chances are you have bits of this and that hanging around the shed; motor oil here, spark plug there, drain pan somewhere...you get the idea. The first thing you will notice is the container is a funnel and drain pan. It's a smart idea since this actually serves a purpose and is sized right. Next, the spark plug, filter and fluid is all packed inside and designed so you can do maintenance all at once. The value seems solid especially compared to buying each individually and I like the time saving aspect. I got two because we actually have a couple of mowers - one we use for personal and one we use for rentals. Both arrived in good order, both are convenient and both seemed well priced.

This kit is convenient if you don't mind after-market parts.The kit includes Champion brand oil SAE30, air filter, spark plug and fuel stabilizer all neatly packaged in a plastic container that doubles as a funnel and drain pan.Pros:-All in one kit saves having to shop around.-Includes container that can be used as a drain pan and funnel.Cons:-Parts may not be exact replacements for your mower.  For example, the spark plug is a Champion brand replacement not an OEM NGK plug.  That may not be a big deal for you but I want to make you aware of what you are getting.  Also, the plug may not be gapped correctly for your mower so be sure to check that.  You should check it even if you buy an NGK plug.-Included oil is not Honda's exact recommendation.  My Honda manual recommends 10W30 but says SAE30 is also okay if temperature is over 65 F.-The plastic container is the thickness of a plastic water bottle and the cover does not fit tightly enough to store the used oil until you recycle it.  If you knock it over, the oil will spill out so don't use the container to drive the oil to your recycling station or you if you stop fast you will have a mess all over your car.
summary: Nice kit if you don't mind after-market parts but double check to be sure everything is correct for your mower.

reviewText: This is an excellent kit for a quick tune up for the lawn mower. The kit price is a dollar or two less than what I would typically pay for a quart of SAE30W oil, filter, fuel stabilizer and spark plug alone; an additional bonus is that plastic kit container top is a convenient funnel, and the bottom makes a handy drain pan, which would be a couple more dollars for those who may not have one on hand. It's a good deal for anyone who wants to do the complete maintenance.
summary: Filter, Plug, Oil, Fuel Stabilizer with Bonus Funnel and Pan

reviewText: I like how easily this stored on the shelf.  It's made so it will store great alongside things like bottles of antifreeze or large containers of oil - it's sorta squared off on the sides so it fits in neatly.It has a built in funnel that's very stable and easy to use - a huge bonus and great packaging design.  The bottom functions as a container for the used oil.My dad was a mechanic for years, and he always stocked Champion spark plugs as his primary brand because he had a lot of experience with it and always said it was a great brand.  Usually just the spark plug will cost you about $4 here - in fact, you'd probably spend $5-6 bucks more buying all these products separately.  Just check your engine on your equipment to make sure you get the right kind for what you have.

This product is made by Champion and is a neatly designed kit for someone who wants to do his/her own maintenance on Honda engines (5 HP and up). Included in the kit is a spark plug, air filter, four cycle oil and fuel stabilizer. The really cool thing about this is that the package containing the items converts to an oil funnel and drain pan.Someone needs to get an award for the design of this. Very clever.

I was honestly a little unsure if this kit was something I could do on my own. Once it arrived I read the directions and set out to do the tune-up myself. Come to find out it was so easy I even ordered a kit to do my grandmother's mower as well.

I absolutely love this Champion Honda Lawn Mower Tune-Up Kit.  I had no idea I needed to do maintenance on my mower.  I would just put my mower in the shed and forget about it until spring.  Then I would deal with it being tough to start, curse at it, call friends who might know what happened, etc.  This past spring I did hunt down the correct air filter and spark plug to fit.  Just buying oil to keep on hand for adding to the engine over the season can get costly.  That means that having this kit with everything together is so convenient, makes it stress free, and costs much less than buying everything separately.  I also LOVE the large funnel that comes from the lid.  I'm anxious for fall to come so that I can add the fuel stabilizer to my gas tank (I've never done that before).

It's nice having a kit like this with everything in one spot. The items are not true Honda OE if that is worrisome to you. However you can't be denied warranty coverage according to the Magnuson-Moss Act for using aftermarket parts.Like my subject said, no synthetic? The two biggest things you can do for small high compression engines is use ethanol free gas and synthetic oils. So find your local ethanol free station and replace this oil with synthetic and you're in great shape!

reviewerName: Nathan Andersen "Gadget lover and author of S...
reviewText: This is a very handy little kit, that gives everything you need for an annual tuneup on the HRR mower.Comes with oil, an air filter, a new spark plug, and fuel stabilizer (great for adding into the gas can to preserve its quality when you aren't using it very frequently - especially if you let it sit over the winter).The top, as advertised, works as a funnel; and the rest of the package works great as a pan for the oil you're getting rid of.Not sure what else to say about this - I usually buy these separately, but I usually buy all of them (except for the spark plug, which I've never changed yet, and haven't seemed to need to), including an extra funnel. Having one of these on hand ahead of time, ordered online, is not a bad idea since it saves a trip to the hardware store some morning when what you really want is just to get the lawn mowed before it gets hot.
summary: Everything you need to tune-up your Honda mower (short of a sharpener)

reviewText: This is one awesome kit and a great value.  It's very handy to have it all-in-one like this, with the storage container that converts to funnel and pan andthat you can take it to recycling when finished.Contents:Champion Spark Plug Part #RN11YC4Honda Air Filter: 17211-Z68-000, 17211-Z68-003End of Season Fuel Stabilizer: 2.5 Fl OzOil: SAE 30W SJ 20 Fl OzI would highly recommend it.
summary: One handy lawn mower tune-up kit

reviewText: This clever idea is pretty darn awesome!  First of all, the container rocks.  It comes apart and the top part becomes a really nice funnel and the bottom part can be used as a bucket or for whatever you need.  Then the little thing of oil and the filter are nice and handy to have around.  I keep it in my garage and I feel good knowing those things are there for when I'll need them.
Loved this product! It has everything that you need for tuning up your lawnmower plus the plastic container can be used as a funnel(which I used several times).Will buy in the future!

This is a handy collection of the things you need to give your Honda lawn mower a tune up.  I like that the package becomes the funnel and the container you drain the old oil into.  The only part of the kit that I don't really need is the fuel stabilizer.  I run my mower out of gas in the fall and my gas container is small enough that I use it up before the gas would go bad.

This kit has almost everything you need to keep your mower running well. You get fuel stabilizer, oil, spark plug, and air filter in the kit. The packaging converts into a funnel and drain pan for the used oil allowing for a convenient oil change with hopefully fewer spills. The only thing you really need to actually do the plug change is a spark plug wrench which isn't included. Overall this is a very nice package with almost everything you need for quick and easy maintenance to keep your mower running well.
summary: Handy kit with almost everything you need

reviewText: This little kit is handy.  It has everything I needed for my annual tuneup and you can use the container as a funnel and drain pan.  The price on this is cheaper than buying the same items from my local store and I don't have to search and double check to make sure I have all the right items.  Just buy and go, very smart idea.
summary: All that I need for my Honda

reviewerName: Wendi Barker "Wendi's Book Corner & What Wend...
reviewText: When I showed my husband this tune-up kit, he encouraged me to do it myself (and had fun laughing at me as I tried to get the oil dipper out - it had gotten stuck shut).Overall, this was EASY to use, and included everything to give our mower a tune-up.Prior to doing this tune-up, we had to pull the starting cord a lot to get the mower to fire up, after, it took just one pull.Luckily, we have a spark plug tool that helps pull the old one out and put the new one in - using a socket wrench (hope that was the correct tool).  The filter slipped in easily.  The kit container is used to drain the old oil into, and you use the top as a funnel to pour the new oil in.This made a huge difference in how well our mower started up!We did not use the fuel stabilizer yet as we will add it in the fall prior to storing the mower for the winter.This was a great, easy to use kit that improved the ease of starting our mower and keeping it running smoothly.
summary: SO Easy to Use, and Mower Works Like New Again

reviewText: This is a handy kit offered at a reasonable price.  It includes everything you'll need to maintain your mower:  oil, air filter, spark plug and gasoline stabilizer.  And the packaging itself is designed to be your funnel and oil pan.  The positives: compact design, very reasonable price and you get everything you need in one convenient package.  The negatives: no instructions or tool to change the spark plug, no easy way to measure out less that the full amount of stabilizer (assuming you don't fill your gas tank) and I'd recommend using a sturdier funnel and oil pan. The plastic container was cracked on delivery so the Champion funnel was unusable.  Finally, the caveat:  make sure these components fit to your B&S engine.  One easy thing to do is to compare the photo of the air filter with the one on your engine.  They are not all the same so beware before purchasing.  But all-in-all a nice design and a convenient way to ensure you keep your mower in top operating condition.
summary: Useful kit at a good price

reviewText: I guess I should take that partially back.  The kit comes in a drop pan/funnel combination packaging that you can use a couple of times if needs be.  I guess if you don't have an oil pan/drop pan or a funnel, then it would be very useful for some time (because I would infer that you don't do many oil changes at home, not posessing these items already).  I would think the pan/funnel might last as long as or longer than the tune-up in that case.The nitty-gritty: Everything in the kit except the spark plug (which is an actual Champion) is rebranded as Champion.  The oil and stabilizer are branded Federal-Mogul (Champion), but aren't.  Only the plug and filter are actually Federal-Mogul (Champion) products.  Okay, so what?  Well, I saw another reviewer note that the kit included "Champion oil", so I thought I would clear that up...and Kenmore refrigerators are usually Fridigidaire, not Sears...just sayin'.Anyway, in the end, the kit fits the old, standard small Briggs engines (verticals), leaves you far better off than without a tune-up, and the price is fair.  You might usually do without the stabilizer, but if you factor in a (retail) $5 air filter, a $2.50 quart of SAE 30 oil, a $2.50+ spark plug, the cheapest drop pan and funnel you could get at Wally World and just save the stabilizer to use at the end of the season, I would say you're not doing any worse than you would do 'a la carte' at the parts house or the lawn and garden section...the stabilizer is basically free.  I'm used to the green foam filter, but the consistency not the color of the foam is the important part.End game: if you have no idea about what parts to buy, but you can read the "4.5 Quattro" sticker on top of your push mower, find one of these kits every couple of years and just do it.  It'll save you a trip or two to the mechanic eventually, which isn't so much worth a lot of straight money, but the time and aggravation saved is priceless.  Eventually, your mower will break or wear out, but proper maintenance will delay that inevitable end, and this kit is as good a way as any for the casual homeowner to do a little preventive maintenance every coupla years.(You must clean your air filter far more often than you replace it, by the way...at least a couple of times per season, depending on how dusty you get.  Blow your nose after mowing, and use that as a gauge.  Gross, I know, but it's a pretty good indicator!  Check the oil *every* time you're going to start it...trust me.  While you have the mower in position to drain the oil, it's a nice time to pull the blade and sharpen it...use a short 2X4 board to wedge the blade against the discharge chute.  YouTube has videos on proper blade-sharpening techniques.  There's nothing wrong with using a mid-sized or big file, and balancing it by hanging it on a small nail to see if one end is heavy...just sayin'.  Mower maintenance isn't sorcery.  Ya just gotta do it, and this kit makes it a little easier.)
summary: Mechanics review: good kit, nothing new

reviewText: I ordered this for my 4.5 hp Briggs and Stratton Engine on my lawn edger. Make sure you have the right model; mine wasn't. I should not have just assumed it would work. All in all this is a very handy kit because it contains all of the servicing parts; oil, carb filter, spark plug as well as the gas stabilizer. Gas stabilizer should be placed in your main fuel container so it is used on all of your garden equipment starting in mid to late summer. Gasoline with alcohol in it tends to absorb moisture, and has a shelf life that is far less than the olden days of non-alcohol gas. You never know when you are going to do a fill up in late season that will be the last for the season, so it is a good idea to start using the fuel stabilizer early. The real challenge is that trying to drain fuel from a mower is near impossible. You could however put a little in the tank, shake it up, and then run it for 5 minutes in order for it to go completely into your system/carburetor.The reason why I mentioned to get the right kit is that even though it was a Briggs and Stratton 4.5hp the spark plug was wrong, the filter was wrong, and the fill funnel top wouldn't work as in you could not get access properly. It is handy that they place this in a container that is housed with a drain bucket bottom, and a funnel top. So it is a well engineered kit. The convenience of having all of the parts right there instead of having to shop for them individually is a big benefit.
summary: Great Unit. Make sure you get the right kit.

reviewText: We recently purchased a new Craftsman, Briggs and Stratton Engine mower and thought this would be perfect for the fall or next spring tune-up. The oil that comes with this was the perfect amount for the mower, the air filter will fit perfectly, and the spark plug and fuel chem are brand name. No junkies in this box. The only complaint I have is that the funnel side wasn't working. It popped off the bottom unit OK, but the black nozzle on top refused to come off. We tried pliers and eventually resorted to kitchen shears to cut it off. Maybe it was just our funnel and cap, but I can't say without purchasing a second one to look at. This is the reason I give it 4 instead of 5 stars.
summary: Had everything I needed for the new mower!

reviewText: The product is nice and versatile in that the bottle which it ships in becomes the funnel and drain as well. They give you the components that you would need to replace - oil, air filter, spark plug and fuel stabilizer.Note: to replace the spark plug you will need additional tools (socket and wrench, etc.). But most of the time you really only need to replace the oil and air filter.I like this product since it's a nice package deal to help people keep their lawn mover serviced, without a steep price!

This fit the bill for my B&S engine maintenance routine for the summer season and I'll have the gas stabilizer on hand for winter storage as well.  Guys may be happy shopping for all these parts, but I like very much having them all in one package.  I don't drain my oil but have a contraption that sucks it out so I offered this container to my son to use on his lawnmower.  He immediately wanted the whole kit, so now I'll have to buy another :).  Maybe guys like it all together too.  Great idea.  I'll be looking for a similar kit for my other engines.
summary: Nice to have it all together

reviewText: The Champion tune-up kits have everything you need in one kit. It includes the air filter, spark plug, oil and  fuel stabilizer.This one is for Briggs & Stratton engines 3.5 - 4.5 HP.Champion Spark Plug - Part # RJ19LMBriggs & Stratton air filter: 5088D, 698369The package is very convenient, you get everything you need in one kit and the container also can be used for a drain pan and funnel. The funnel could be kept if you need one or you can just top the bottom bucket back off with the used oil in it and dispose of it properly.Great deal for the price and a brilliant idea to include everything in a kit. Takes out having to guess as to which parts you need for your motor. The price for the kit is cheaper than if you bought all the pieces separately.

Poor mowers...if you're anything like me, they're consistently overlooked in terms of annual maintenance. It's hard to know/find the exact parts and requirements for the specific mower and since they're only used for a season, they're easy to neglect. That's why this tune-up kit is perfect, it's got everything you need to keep your mower's engine running effectively in one kit. The filter and spark plug couldn't be easier to install and I love that the base of the container can be used to catch the draining oil while the top doubles as an oil funnel.If you've thought: I probably should do some maintenance on my mower - then buy this kit, you won't be disappointed and you won't be burdened with a ton of time invested in running down parts and working on the mower.

This set worked perfectly for our little old mower. I loved having all the components there. It is a great way to teach a kid about engine maintenance. I had no problem using it. It seems as cost effective to me as purchasing the various elements separately and I didn't have to worry about forgetting anything.

The Briggs and Stratton Classic one cylinder motor has been powering outdoor equipment like lawn mowers for decades and is very reliable and durable. There are only 4 ways to stop them, and this kit addresses all 4 - lubrication, ignition, fuel, air.1. This kit includes small engine motor oil -which is a little different from automotive motor oil. It is a single grade SAE 30 vs 5W-30. and the quantity is right for the B&S; Classic. Change the oil every 30 hours to keep the motor properly lubricated. The container for this kit acts like a funnel to get the oil into the oil filler port.2. If the engine begins burning oil or you use poor quality fuel, the spark plug can become fouled. A dirty spark plug will prevent the engine from igniting the  fuel. Change the spark plug to prevent misfiring and keep the power output optimal.3. Gasoline has a limited shelf life. Over time gasoline evaporates leaving behind varnish that clogs the passages in the carburetor. This kit includes gasoline stabilizer that prevents gas from decomposing for as long as two years. Before storing your mower for the season add the fuel stabilizer from this kit to the fuel.4. All gasoline engines use more air than fuel. So, if you cut off the air supply it will suffocate. The air filter will help keep dirt out of the air intake system, but movers operate in dusty conditions, so the air filter can become clogged.The B&S; Classic filter can be washed, but sooner or later it must be replaced. The filter in this kit fits the B&S; Classic, Sprint and Quattro engines perfectly. It takes only a minute or two to change and you may be surprized at the difference a clean filter can make.
summary: Annual maintenance kit for your B&S engine

reviewText: nice kit, fits like a charm for my mower and everything was of a good quality. only issue is the funnel part. The cap does NOT come off for some reason. I bought two of these and neither cap would not twist off. I had to cut them off with tin snips but it was just the cap so no big deal.

This kit is convenient and includes all champion branded items.The kit includes Champion brand oil SAE30, air filter, spark plug and fuel stabilizer all neatly packaged in a plastic container that doubles as a funnel and drain pan.  Just be sure the oil is the right type and viscosity for your mower.Pros:-All in one kit saves having to shop around.-Includes container that can be used as a drain pan and funnel.Cons:-Parts may not be exact replacements for your mower.-Container will leak if knocked over.  Top and bottom pieces do not fit very tightly.  After you fill the mower with oil, I'd transfer the used oil to a different container.
summary: Nice kit but double check to be sure everything is correct for your mower.

reviewerName: Lettetia "As Long As I Am Able To Read, I Sha...
reviewText: Champion BS12 Lawn and Garden Tune-Up Kit, 3.5HP-4.5HP Briggs & Stratton Classic, Sprint, Quattro Engines was used this week to tune up our lawn mower with exceptional results.  Everything you need is included in the package; in fact, the packaging itself is part of the tune-up process.  The funnel is the top of the packaging, while the bottom becomes the vessel to catch oil and overflow.  Great idea!  I am very pleased with the results and plan to purchase this item again in the future.

The Champion tune-up kit contained just what I expected -- good quality Champion parts (air filter, oil, spark plug, and fuel stabilizer) that are all practical and useful.  There is no fluff.  Even the packaging has a function, which was a great idea.  The top can be used as a funnel and the bottom a drain pan.  Unfortunately, the funnel section was cracked.  This may be more of a packaging problem by Amazon than a weakness of the package itself.  It was a bummer, regardless.While I would not advise paying much extra for the handy (if fragile) packaging, this combination is currently a good value if they have a kit that fits your model of mower.  Otherwise, buy all the parts separately, sit them in a Tupperware bowl, and drop a funnel on top.

This all in one Tune up kit is just what I needed, everything in this kit is able to be used for the maintenance of your lawn mower. The package itself splits into a funnel and oil pan, you can empty the oil into the bottom and use the top (mine was cracked in shipping) to put the new oil that is included into your machine. There is also an oil filter, spark plug, and fuel stabilizer in this kit.

This is a great tune up kit which contains everything that you will need to tune up your lawnmower and keep it in good running condition.  The tune up kit includes a spark plug, air filter, 4-cycle oil and fuel stabilizer.  If your gas gets too old, I always add fuel stabilizer to give the mower easy starting.  The package also converts to an oil funnel and drain pan.  It's a very handy and convenient item to have on hand.

Usually I would say that packaging products together like this is gimmicky and silly, but in this case I think it is a really useful idea.  Getting everything your mower needs in a single package is very convenient and at the current price is even cost effective.  Just make sure you are getting the right kit for your model mower.
summary: Convenient to have everything you need in one package.

reviewText: I like the fact that the container is used for the oil pan and oil funnel.  The air filter and spark plug were perfect replacements right down to the model number.  The 20oz oil included was plenty and not having to buy extra fuel stabilizer for the end of the season is an added bonus.  I will definitely use this again.
summary: Perfect Part replacements for the Toro super recycler

reviewText: used this on the lawn mower.  it has the basic stuff that you need to give the mower a quick tune up.  depending on the price of this kit, it could be possible to get your tune up stuff a little cheaper seperately.

Last year I purchased every one of the items in this kit individually. This year I got this Champion lawn mower kit to do the same thing, except at lower overall cost. Actually I got even more considering the oil funnel and drain pan. Previously, I used a plastic milk carton and cut it up with a knife.This is so much more convenient to get everything in one order - not to even mention a lower overall price. I made a terrible mistake last year by leaving gasoline in my virtually new lawn mower for several months.  The fuel clogged my carburetor and no longer reached the combustion chamber.  I tried three times in vain to add gasoline additives to open up the fuel delivery, but the damage was already done.  If I had used the fuel additive from the beginning, I would have avoided this costly mistake.  Of course, the smart thing would have been to drain the gasoline and run the lawn mower until the fuel was consumed. I really like the fact the fuel detergent is included in this kit.  I never knew the value until it was too late. From this point forward, I will always order this lawn mower kit every year.
summary: All-In-One Tune-Up Kit - Very Convenient and Complete

reviewText: This is the all-inclusive tune-up kit for a Briggs and Stratton 3.5 to 6.5 HP Quantum Engine, which is one of the most common lawn mower engines out there.  I have the 6.5 HP engine, which takes 20 oz of oil, so for me there is no guessing about how much goes in, since the kit comes with a 20 oz bottle. The included spark plug was already gapped correctly out of the box, and the air filter (blue foam gasket) swapped right out with the existing one, so including the oil change, the tune up only took me about 15 minutes.  It is good practice to change your plug, oil and air filter at least seasonally, and to check them regularly to keep your mower in good running condition.  Everything you need is right in this kit.  They also include a bottle of fuel stabilizer to add to a 5 gallon can, so they have your gas covered too.The container doubles as a funnel and drain pan too, so you get a 20 oz bottle of SAE30 4-cycle motor oil, air filter, Champion spark plug, a 2.5 oz bottle of fuel stabilizer, and the funnel/pan container for about the price of the filter and plug if purchased separately.  Unfortunately, my container and funnel arrived broken due damage during shipping and so was unusable -but wouldn't have been a deal breaker for me anyway.  Still, I notified Amazon that their packaging was pretty light for the contents, so hopefully they will take better care in the future. Other than that, this is everything you should need for your annual mower tune up, in one package.
summary: Champion BS11 Lawn Mower Tune-Up Kit, Briggs and Stratton 3.5 to 6.5 HP Quantum Engines

reviewText: I've had a Troy Built mower for the last 8 years and have never changed the spark plug, I rarely changed the air filter and changed the oil about once every 3 years. But the thing still runs strong and starts within 2 or 3 pulls. Well I'm trying to treat my tools better so I got this lawn mower tune up kit and gave it a go.So, how did it work?The packaging on this is clever. the top comes off and is used as a funnel to refill your oil, the bottom is where you drain your old oil into. Inside the carton is a spark plug, air filter, oil and fuel stabilizer for end of season, since it's the beginning of mowing season I didn't use the stabilize yet but will save that for the end of the season.First, the spark plug, was a perfect fit, in fact I compared the numbers on it and it matched up. Swapping it out was easy, take a socket wrench, do one turn and it hand unscrews the rest of the way out. The new one screws in just as easy.The air filter replaced easily as well. One screw the old one came out and was caked with dirt. The new one went in and the screw replaced, done.The oil, that was interesting. I drained the old oil with little issue. A tip for you though. When you tip your mower over to drain, if you have gas in the tank it can start to leak out the top cap. A simple solution to this is to take a plastic sandwich bag, or even the air filter bag, unscrew the gas cap, put the bag over it and replace the cap. Now you have a fuel tight seal. Just make sure to remove the plastic bag before you try to use your mower. :)So, when I tried to replace the oil I couldn't get the black cap off of the "funnel" part of the packaging. I tried, pulled, unscrewed, it just wouldn't budge. In fact at one point I wound up knocking over the bottom part of the container holding the old oil spilling it on my driveway while fighting to get the cap off... It wasn't worth it. I quickly cleaned up the spilled oil, and just poured the new oil in without a funnel, in fact I didn't even need the funnel as it just made a bigger mess.Once I was done, my mess cleaned up I pulled the cord and the mower fired right up. I  mowed the lawn and the mower sounded and ran much better. This is a great kit, works very well and is easy to take care of your mower. I'd just advise to skip the funnel top.

nice product and perfect fit for mower. the only issue is that the top for the funnel does not come off. I have two separate kits and the top does not come off on either of them. I had to cut it off but works well otherwise.

This champion lawn mower tune up kit made it possible for me to tune up the mower alone. Normally I have to hire someone for it to be sure it is done right. This kit makes it so easy. Everything you need is in there for a tune up (except tools). This is very convenient. I can see myself buying this again.

I'll admit that we don't always keep up with the maintenance on our lawn mower.  It's dirty and heavy, and it sits in the barn between uses - out of sight, out of mind.I got this Champion Tune Up Kit, and decided that I was going to try to do it myself. I'm happy to say that it was fast, easy, and not messy at all.  It took me about a minute to get the old spark plug loosened up without breaking it (we have a spark plug socket), but the new plug was a perfect match and screwed right in.  The new air filter was also just like the dirty one (extremely dirty!) and installed easily.Changing the oil was slightly harder but I managed to do it without spilling, breaking or losing anything.  I ran the engine for a minute or two, to warm up the oil, then wiped around the oil plug (where an inch of grass and dirt had built up) before opening the plug.  I tipped the mower to drain the old oil out (into the included cup) and then replaced the plug.  Next I used the included funnel to pour in the new oil and I was done!  I saved the gas treatment for this fall, when we put the mower away for the season.  I have the cup and funnel full of old oil ready to take to our local transfer station, for safe recycling.Now there's no excuse for not doing the basic maintenance that will keep your Briggs and Stratton engine running at its best.  If I can do it, so can you!
summary: Our lawn mower runs like new again

reviewText: The container that should have served as an oil pan had a 3-inch crack in it, making it unusable for catching oil -- at least it would have if my husband hadn't duct-taped the crack closed.  We weren't able to take the oil to the recycler in the oil pan, but it held long enough to finish the oil change, and then my husband poured the oil into the now-empty oil bottle.Having a kit like this is great.  We didn't have to go out and buy everything separately, because it comes with the correct spark plug, air filter, oil and fuel stabilizer. As icing on the cake, the top can be used as a funnel, and the container (if it's not cracked) can be used as a drain pan.The only extras we needed were a 3/8" ratchet (and 6" extension), a spark plug socket and a flat head screwdriver.  If you do your own tune-ups, you'll probably already have those tools.
summary: Everything I need, all in one place, except...

reviewText: I've owned my Craftsman lawn mower for about 7 years and so far have not ever done any maintenance on it. I am not sure why, but I think it was because I was too lazy to find out the plug number and it was still running fine. THe oil looks clean still too, even though I've never changed it either. So when this kit came up, I thought, "why not?"Included in the kit is oil, a plug, a fuel stabilizer and a spark plug. The kit holder acts as a oil drain pan But the coolest thing? It actually includes all the right parts! I looked it up in my manual (finally) and it has all the right numbers for the air filter, plug and the right weight of oil. The oil drain pan and filler funnel being part of the packing is really neat.This makes the kit extremely convenient ... all the right part all in the same place. Everything, of course, works as expected. As long as you have a nice standard Briggs and Stratton engine on your mower, you're set.

Let me say first off . . . make sure you get the right kit . . . or the air filter won't fit.  This kit is for any mower with a Briggs & Stratton 3.5 to 6.5 QUANTUM Series engine.  The Quantum engines have a vertically mounted air filter unit on the forward right side of the engine, which utilizes a paper air filter element with an integral blue foam gasket, overall dimension 4.4" x 5" (B&S; part number 491588S, which is printed on the side of the paper filter media).OK, if you've got the right mower match, let me comment that this is a very nicely put together kit.  It all comes enclosed in a plastic container and contains everything you need for basic annual maintenance and storage.  Price is very competitive, especially if you add a little extra value considering the top of the container converts to a re-usable funnel and the body to a used oil catch can (or for me, a handy parts bin for new and old mower parts, or nuts & bolts, etc.).  The contents are name brand parts/products, not a collection of cheap compatibles.Included in the kit:  1. 20 oz bottle of SAE 30 Champion brand 4-cycle lawn mower motor oil.  2. Briggs & Stratton air filter for the Quantum engine. 3. Champion Copper Plus spark plug.  4. 2.5 oz bottle of Champion Fuel Stabilizer, enough to treat over 5 gallons of gasoline (in your storage can) and the fuel in your mower's tank.  As I mentioned, the container also provides a funnel and small parts bin.A good idea and a decent deal.

Few people realize the true mileage they can get out of their Briggs and Stratton powered equipment because they never do a tune-up and oil change. This is a simple kit with which you can change your oil, air filter, and spark plug. It comes with a ready made funnel and drain pan. You will need a screwdriver, plug socket, and a wrench to finish the job but with these engines access is simple. The oil is SAE 30 SJ grade and designed for warm weather but still should work well in a snow blower that is kept in an attached garage. I would not recommend this oil for use where you must start the engine at below 32 degrees F. In these instances a lighter oil is often recommended but read your owners manual to be sure because some still specify 30 weight oil at cold temperatures. All in all this should make your small engine maintenance a quick and easy job!

UPDATE #2:  I contacted Teho with their toll-free phone number and told them about the problem with the pruner.  My first surprise was learning that I was talking to someone not only in the United States, but actually at the Teho company headquarters (kind of sad that that's so surprising nowadays).  The customer service rep agreed that the pruner should not have had this issue and promised to send a new one -- which arrived the very next day, charged up and ready to go.  How nice to have a company stand so rock-solid behind their products.  My faith in the products is restored, and I'm really glad to have the pruner again!UPDATE #1: I used the pruner about 10 times last year, then stored it according to the instructions (no freezing, charge every 6 months). Took it out for the first time today and it no longer works. The spotlight comes on, but that's all. I will replace it, but not with this brand.ORIGINAL:I've done reviews where I wished I could give the product less than 1 star, but this is the first one that's made me wish I could give 6!  I love this garden set.  It's on my Top 10 list of gadgets I would replace immediately if they stopped working.I had an old set with a small hedge trimmer like this, so my expectations were pretty realistic, and the trimmer met them easily.  I used it on a variety of yew, juniper, and boxwood shrubs as well as a couple deciduous bushes.  Like all smaller trimmers, I wouldn't want to use this for major hedge trimming, but it can't be beat for smaller work and detailing.  I have a porch railing with evergreen shrubs in front of it, which eventually grow through the spindles.  It was perfect for finessing between the shrub and the porch railing to cut that growth back.  I trimmed for about an hour and noticed it was beginning to lose power slightly, but so was I.  An hour is just about perfect for me.The grass shear was very quick and effective.  I have a large flower bed with grape hyacinths along the edge, and if you have grape hyacinths you know the greenery continues to grow after they have finished their spring bloom.  I have to cut them back occasionally to keep the bed looking neat, and the shears were just the ticket.  The one thing I would have wished for is an extension handle so I wouldn't have to do all the shearing bent over or on my knees.This is the first time I've tried a powered pruner, and it was my favorite of all.  It took a little getting used to, since there is a moment's hesitation between squeezing the handle and making the cut; I'm used to a regular pruner that snips as soon as you close the handle.  However, it made effortless good, clean cuts on any branch small enough to fit between the jaws (and a couple times when I got over-ambitious, I ended up snipping through with two or three cuts, then cleaning up the edge, and it did fine for that, too).  I pruned a very old, woody Chinese tree peony and an overgrown Contorta and soon had a whole garden cart full of trimmings, with the pruner still raring to go.The one other wish I'd have would be for two chargers so both the pruner and the trimmer/grass shear handle could charge at the same time.  However, they charge quickly and hold a charge for a long time off the charger, so this really hasn't been a limitation.  I just like the set so much that I want to be positive it's always ready to go!

My wife is an avid gardener, but hates trimming/pruning as it makes her arms sore.  She was hesitantly thrilled when I gave her this setup.  She charged up the batteries, it shipped with a pretty full charge so it didn't take long to charge.  She then took them out to work.  She came back and was ecstatic.  She trimmed and shaped several bushes, pruned some others, and trimmed grass.  All of the attachments worked perfectly, with no arm pains.  The tools are light, and easy to manipulate.  She cut branches up to 1/2 inch thick with no issues.This is an excellent set of tools that worked better than we could have hoped.  I strongly recommend you try them out.

While they're not rugged enough for routine maintenance of a large yard/garden, this is the perfect set to maintain a small yard or garden, or for quick touch-ups on larger property. They charge quickly, and each charge seems to last about 15 minutes for the hedge trimmer/cutter, somewhat less for the pruner, definitely long enough for routine maintenance of a small yard.I was frankly very surprised that such light tools did such a good job. Again, not suitable for heavy gardening, but great for smaller gardens/touch-ups.I have a several acres, but I also have a much smaller courtyard, about the size of an average residential city yard, and this kit was just about right. The courtyard includes small trees, large shrubs, herbs, grass, and a few perennials. The hedge clippers worked well shaping the new growth of old evergreen shrubs, and the pruner handled the older growth well, as well as the branches on my young peach tree, and pruning out the nuisance mulberries that keep coming up along the foundation. The trimmer worked well for edging grass along sidewalks and flower beds, cutting back medium weeds at the edges of my vegetable garden, and cutting back flowerheads on herb beds.The great thing about this set is that the pieces are lightweight, great if you have troubled wrists. They are much less effort/strain than operating their manual counterparts, but they do require a bit more effort than I would like to engage both the operational buttons and safety mechanism. Unlike larger garden power tools, including those with the removable batteries (which typically run a bit longer), these are quite lightweight, so although there's a little strain keeping the safety and triggers engaged, that strain isn't compounded by the weight of the tool itself. So you have a net reduction in hand/wrist/lower arm strain, vs. both manual tools and heavier power tools.If you're sloppy about maintaining your yard, this set won't be enough for aggressive weed growth (you'll still need a weed eater), but if you keep up with it, this would even let you skip a weed eater/edger on a small yard.It's a nice compact set for small spaces. I wish it came with a 2nd charger, as it's more of PITA to remember to rotate them to keep them both charged, but that's my only complaint.
summary: Perfect set for a small-to-medium yard/garden, or touchups on a larger plot

reviewText: I wanted to trim around a bamboo plant and it was so tedious when doing it by hand. The clippers work great and get the job done quickly. Would be great when cleaning a plot at the cemetery also. I have not used the hedge trimmer and don't have need for a power trimmer but I tried it and it does the job - just don't push the handle until the blades are on the branch. Takes getting use to. Here's hoping the clippers have a long life because they are great.

This is the coolest lawn and garden tool ever!  The battery charges quickly to full charge...less than an hour, and holds the charge long enough to complete any task.  The pruner is amazing.  Instead of having to squeeze a manual pruner until your fingers hurt, one click of the trigger and the branch is snipped off.  True, it will only cut branches up to 1/2" diameter, but that is all my regular pruners do.  The hedge trimmer is excellent as well, and so lightweight that it takes much less effort to use.  There is no cord to worry about cutting by mistake, and your arms and shoulders aren't worn out by lifting a heavy trimmer.All I have used the shear for was to try it for deadheading some geraniums which it did with ease.  For me, that is the least useful utensil as I don't see that I will have a great need for deadheading or trimming grass with this tool.  It does work quite well, so if you have no string trimmer and need to edge along a fence or garden this would do the trick.Highly recommended for anyone who does any outside work on their landscaping.
summary: A great gift for someone who has everything or nothing

reviewText: I thought for sure that I would really enjoy using this product.  I found the tools to be fairly bulky (but not heavy), the "power" level generated from these tools is only fair, and the pruner could be down-right dangerous if one is not SUPER careful. The plastic guards for the trimmer and shear blades, which should be in place when not in use, is really cheaply made and will crack and be broken in no time at all.  The plastic guard for the pruner however is much more sturdy and will last a very long time.I do like that the pruner has an LED light that you can activate prior to depressing the cutting switch.  This will allow the user to better see what is being cut.  I found that the pruner did not cut as cleanly as I suspected and often it struggled with branches that were smaller than what it claimed could be easily cut and the button to activate the pruner would have to be pushed 2 or 3 times to completely cut through the branch.  The blade on the pruner can be easily replaced by pulling up a green lever and considering how expensive this product is, I was more than a little surprised that at least one additional blade wasn't included.Overall, if you have an assortment of quality gardening tools, I suspect that you won't fall in love with this product (the exception might be those gardeners who are experiencing arthritis and find that manually working a pruner is no longer a comfortable option).  I's not a bad product, I just found that it wasn't any more useful than my current tools and the added burden of charging it before use (not to mention keeping track of the charger), keeping it dry, and having to handle it more delicately than traditional tools (if dropped on a hard surface - you really run the risk of it breaking) made it a bit too high maintenance for my liking.  I also found that it took longer to prune with the TEHO pruner and I couldn't reach as easily into tight spots.  The only tool that produced faster results was the hedge trimmer.  For small jobs, such as trimming up perennials once they are done flowering, the hedge trimmer made really quick work of tidying everything up.Good luck with your gardening!
summary: Nothing Special - I prefer my traditional gardening tools

reviewText: These tools are great!  They are lightweight and easy to handle.  They have a safety feature that you need to press 2 buttons at one time but are designed in such a nice way that it is easy. All the blades have guards. The charger is similar to a cell phone and just plug in an outlet, therefore no charging station to deal with. They charge quickly and hold the charge for about an hour.The performance is wonderful, you just zip along except the pruners which to me seem slower to use than the manual pruners. However, if you have arthritis or lack of hand strength, these power pruners are a blessing.There is a 2 year warranty and lithium batteries which are a plus.Highly recommend!
summary: Love these garden tools...great if you have arthritic hands/wrists

reviewText: This set of tools comes with a Pruner and a Shear/ Trimmer, both are cordless and rechargeable. And while they are great for any gardener, I would say they are a must have for an elderly gardener who just doesn't have the strength or endurance to use regular tools. All of the tools come with sheaths to protect the blades (and you) from harm.Now lets look at each tool, one at a time;The Pruner can cut up to 1/2 inch green and about 1/3 inch dead wood. It can also cut larger pieces in multiple cuts. It has a very long run time, almost an hour and it recharges very fast. I took an hour lunch and it was done recharging before I was. Another nice touch are two LED lights. Sometimes when I am shaping up a large hedge, I have to crawl under it to get the back side away from the wall. These light make it easier to work underneath. And of course they also work as an emergency flashlight.The Shear/Trimmer is a single tool with exchangeable heads. The shear is great for cutting grasses, especially good for trimming back ornamental grasses. But it may be best suited for dead-heading flowering bushes and perennials like roses. Cutting off the dying blooms will extend the blooming time of most flowers. Now the Hedge Trimmer is too small to trim your entire hedge, but it is perfect for keeping it trimmed afterwards. It is also good for getting the grass and weeds underneath it where your mower and trimmer can't reach without damaging the hedge.Overall these are magnificent tools for any gardener to have.
summary: An excellent addition to your Garden Shed

reviewText: I live on 5 acres and have many bushes, plants, and trees to contend with.  I have an electric set of trimmers, which only reach as far as the longest power cord goes, and in the past, have actually cut the power cord with the trimmer, as the unit is so heavy and hard to control.  This cordless set is just what I need in so many ways!  The trimmer does pretty well trimming bushes.  It's a nice unit, and lightweight.The pruning shears are what I adore about this set.  It's a handy little tool that packs a punch and trims branches on my hardwood trees that I never imagined it would have the power to do!  Anything the pruner blades can fit around, it cuts like butter.  Not only is it a sharp and powerful pruning tool, but it's easy to handle and gets you into tight areas that handheld cutters can't.  And - without sore wrists afterwards!As someone with weak wrists related to advancing age, I really appreciate this set.  I trimmed and pruned for a solid hour, alternating tools, and the units never slowed down.  They cut and cut, even though the maintenance manual says they do not come fully charged.This set comes with chargers and everything you need to maintain it.  I wholeheartedly agree with other reviewers who say this set would make a great gift for the gardener or lawn care enthusiast!
summary: Fantastic Set!  More Power Than Expected!

reviewText: Maintenance is the key word for this kit.  What I mean by maintenance is that its not meant for serious trimming just touchups. All 3 trimmers have their limits of how much/size they can cut. For most people who need to upkeep their gardens, they will be very happy with these trimmers. If you are looking to do heavy trimming/cutting then you'll need electric tools. The pruners clip well but will only handle softer 1/2 inch twigs/branches, etc. The blade itself isn't super thick but you can replace it if it gets dull or if it happens to bend (separate purchase). The hedge trimmer is lightweight and easy to hold as well as being cordless gives you freedom to sculpt hedges nicely. The hedge can only handle up to 1/4 diameter trimmings. It doesn't have too much power behind it so again its just for light maintenance. I had no problems running them thru my evergreen shrubs to give them a nice shape. The shear attachment easily interchanges with the hedge blade and also does a great job on grasses and any other types of thin plants.Both (2) trimmers have a fairly fast charge with a red to green LED. It comes with the A/C adapter but only one so you have to charge the 2 units one at a time. The lithium ion battery claims to last 40 minutes of continuous use. I used the hedge trimmer unit on and off for over 30 minutes and it still worked. Both units have safety switches so they don't accidentally turn on. The trimmers being lightweight are easy to hold and I think they would be good for people with arthritis. They seem to be weighted in the right spot so its not front heavy which keeps pressure off your wrists.There are other comparable major brand names out there but many have less voltage only 3.6 that cost almost the same for just the sheer or hedge trimmer. You get 3 in this kit (one pruner, one hedge clipper with blades that swap out for sheers). If you are looking for a cordless trimmer set for touchups that is easy to use these may be what you are looking for.
